title: Wire manual measurements into Dataset Candidate creation
purpose: Compose the independently owned manual-measurement row transaction with the Dataset creation seam without adopting daily check-in proof or changing canonical pH/EC semantics.
success_outcome: Every newly recorded standalone or check-in-owned ManualMeasurement row atomically creates one manual_measurement Dataset Candidate with exactly one measurement ref and default false trainability; failure rolls back source/candidate together, same-row seam retry deduplicates, distinct rows remain distinct, and canonical pH/EC values, freshness, Timeline, and public results are unchanged.
anti_goals: Daily check-in candidate ownership, pH/EC normalization/freshness changes, evidence association, lifecycle, agent runtime, or historical backfill.
evidence_required: FT-014-AC-010 RED: after TASK-047 and before this wiring, each supported measurement command commits no candidate for measurement_id; GREEN: one exact raw/default candidate and event ref per row commit in the same UoW; decisive comparison: standalone and check-in-owned rows, rollback, same-row retry, distinct-row control, and unchanged measurement/freshness results; artifact: focused PostgreSQL transcript under .tasks/TASK-052-T3-FT-014-W2/.
constraints: One persisted ManualMeasurement row creates one candidate even when the row was created inside create_check_in; TASK-051 separately owns the check-in row candidate.
Do not change fixed-decimal persistence, source_type, trust_status, freshness ordering, or public response shape.
invariants: Measurement values never enter Dataset Timeline payload summaries and never grant trainability by themselves.
Unauthorized/archived Plant operation creates no source row or candidate.
verification_targets: FT-014-AC-010: standalone and check-in-owned measurement matrices with exact source/candidate/audit counts, rollback, same-source idempotency versus distinct row, current authorization/archive, and canonical pH/EC/freshness regression.
